lines.text: Fifty miles north. One bridge. And it was *full.*
lines.style: First-person survivor, out of breath from walking fast, low and tense, the last word dropping like a stone.

lines.text: So we didn't walk on the road. We walked on the *roofs.*
lines.style: Narrating, a grim little smile in the voice, quick, the last word landing with nerve.

lines.text: Don't look down. Don't look at *them.*
lines.style: Teenage girl whispering fast while balancing high up, scared but steady, talking herself through it.
Narrating, slowing down, cold surprise on the last word.
Teenage girl, small broken voice, holding something that hurts to hold, close to tears.

lines.text: Wade and June were gone. And *Biscuit* with them.
lines.style: Narrating, quiet and heavy, a long breath before the dog's name.
Narrating, tense whisper, sizing up a jump, heart pounding.
Narrating, a flash of relief, then the floor dropping out on the last word.
Narrating, a terrified whisper, slow, the last word sharp with horror.

music.title: Last Light - The Bridge
music.style: Cinematic survival score at dusk. A tense ticking pulse and a low cello ostinato that climbs as they cross, taut staccato strings, a wide lonely brass swell when the empty truck is found, then a slow sad piano, then a rising tremolo build to a sudden cut. Instrumental only, no vocals, mixed to sit under dialogue.
